steps.instruction: Drape the tie around the collar.
steps.done_looks_like: The blue tie lies around the white collar with both ends hanging down the shirt front, wide end longer.

checks.text: The wide tie end lies on the white shirt
The narrow tie end lies on the white shirt
The wide tie end looks longer than the narrow tie end
The blue tie lies around the white collar with both ends hanging down the shirt front, wide end longer.

common_mistakes: Wide end shorter than narrow end
Tie twisted with lining facing out

steps.instruction: Cross the wide end over the narrow end.
steps.done_looks_like: The two blue ends cross in the middle of the shirt forming an X below the collar.

checks.text: The wide tie end lies on the white shirt
The narrow tie end lies on the white shirt
The wide end crosses over the narrow end forming an X

common_mistakes: Wide end crossed under instead of over
Cross placed too high or too low
Tie ends twisted at the cross

steps.instruction: Bring the wide end behind and up through the neck loop.
steps.done_looks_like: The wide blue end points up through the neck opening with the crossing cinched below the collar.

checks.text: The wide tie end is above the crossing point near the collar
The wide tie end lies on the white shirt
The wide end went behind the narrow end and up through the neck loop

common_mistakes: Wide end brought over instead of behind
Wide end not pulled through neck loop

steps.instruction: Wrap the wide end across the front.
steps.done_looks_like: A horizontal blue band wraps across the center with the wide end sticking out to the side.

checks.text: The wide tie end lies on the white shirt
The narrow tie end lies on the white shirt
The wide end wraps horizontally across the front forming a loop

common_mistakes: Wrap left loose with no front loop

steps.instruction: Pull the wide end up and down through the front loop.
steps.done_looks_like: The wide blue end hangs down through the front wrap centered over the narrow end.

checks.text: The wide tie end lies on the white shirt
The wide tie end is above the narrow tie end
The wide end went up through the neck and down through the front loop

common_mistakes: Wide end missed the front loop
Wide end pulled through behind the loop

steps.instruction: Tighten and slide the knot to the collar.
steps.done_looks_like: A neat triangular blue knot sits centered under the collar with the wide end hanging straight down the shirt.

checks.text: The wide tie end lies on the white shirt
The wide tie end looks larger than the narrow tie end
The knot is tight, triangular, and slid up to the collar with the wide end covering the narrow end

common_mistakes: Knot left loose away from collar
Narrow end sticking out from behind wide end
